annotations.title: Audit FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflicts of Interest (OCI) & Generate Mitigation Plan

description: Audit existing prime/subcontract awards (SETA, A&AS, IV&V, Systems Engineering, Cloud Architecture) against a target solicitation scope to detect Unequal Access to Information, Biased Ground Rules, and Impaired Objectivity under FAR Subpart 9.5 (FAR 9.505-1 through 9.505-4) and generate an OCI Risk Score (0-100), a 3-Pillar Case-Law Audit Matrix, an Organizational Firewall & NDA Control Matrix, and a ready-to-submit OCI Disclosure & Mitigation Plan volume. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive compliance and legal-engineering generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `new_solicitation_scope_and_oci_clauses` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `existing_contracts_and_corporate_relationships` accepts 20 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool when auditing FAR 9.5 / DFARS 252.209-7008 / 252.209-7009 Organizational Conflicts of Interest or drafting an OCI Mitigation Plan & Non-Disclosure Firewall; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general Section I FAR/DFARS flow-down clause scanning, or `generate_teaming_strategy` to structure 13 CFR 125.6 Prime/Sub workshare splits.

current_and_prior_contracts_portfolio.description: Summary of the bidder's (and any proposed subcontractor's) active or recent prime/sub contracts, SETA/A&AS/IV&V advisory roles, and access to nonpublic source-selection or proprietary third-party data.

target_solicitation_and_sow_text.description: Full or excerpted target RFP scope, PWS/SOW tasks, Section H/I/K/L OCI disclosure instructions, and issuing agency/program office.

name: generate_oci_mitigation_plan

executive_oci_risk_summary.description: Executive legal and capture summary of the OCI audit findings for the Contracting Officer and Capture Director.

oci_clearance_and_defensibility_score.description: 0-100 score indicating how defensible the bidder's OCI posture and mitigation plan are against Contracting Officer exclusion or GAO bid protest.

organizational_firewall_and_nda_controls.description: Concrete organizational, technical (IT/GovCloud enclave), personnel NDA, and workshare carve-out controls.

overall_oci_determination.description: Formal FAR Subpart 9.5 OCI risk determination and pursuit posture recommendation.

ready_to_submit_oci_mitigation_plan_narr.description: Complete, paste-ready Volume I / Section L Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) Disclosure & Mitigation Plan narrative including a FAR 9.505-4 Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) template and Contracting Officer certification block.

three_pillar_far_9_5_audit_matrix.description: Comprehensive audit across all three FAR Subpart 9.5 / GAO OCI pillars: Unequal Access to Information (FAR 9.505-4), Biased Ground Rules (FAR 9.505-1/9.505-2), and Impaired Objectivity (FAR 9.505-3).

title: Audit FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflicts of Interest (OCI) & Generate Mitigation Plan
